title: Safe-output action request
description: One typed action an agent requests. The applier — not the agent — decides whether it runs. Extend the enum and the per-type rules for your system; keep the set closed.

type.description: Closed enumeration of action types. Anything else is rejected.

target.description: The exact resource the action touches (e.g. 'issue/123', 'repo/docs', 'crm/account/42'). Checked against the policy's allow-list.

body.description: Payload for the action (text, patch, field values). Size-limited; never interpreted as a command.

reason.description: Why the agent wants this — logged with the decision for review and evals.
